biotools.summary: CircSeqAlignTk is an R package designed for end-to-end analysis of RNA-seq data from circular genomes, particularly useful for studying organisms like viroids. It offers a user-friendly interface with both command-line and GUI options, and includes features for generating synthetic sequencing data.
